title: Urban Nashville
description:
Spacious East Nashville Retreat Near Downtown ✨
Stay in the heart of East Nashville in this stylish two-bedroom, 2.5-bath home, perfectly located just 1.8 walkable miles from Nissan Stadium. Nestled in a lively, walkable neighborhood with plenty of restaurants to explore, it’s the ideal blend of city energy and home-away-from-home comfort.
Whether you’re here for a concert, a game, or just to experience the vibrant Nashville scene, this home is designed for both comfort and convenience.

The space
2 bedrooms both with king beds.
Room for 1 king or 1 twin air mattress available upon request

Guest access
Guest have access to a fully stocked kitchen, an easy to use pellet grill on a spacious covered porch and two living areas with TV’s

Other things to note
Baby equipment available upon request as well as a rowing machine.
